preconditions.description: The first line is a non-empty string (your name), the second line is a positive integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 100), and there are exactly n action lines following.

preconditions.expression: all(' ' in line for line in stdin.splitlines()[2:]) and all(line.count(' ') == 2 for line in stdin.splitlines()[2:])
preconditions.description: Each action line contains exactly two spaces, splitting into three parts: [actor], [action], [target's post/wall].

preconditions.expression: all('s' in part for part in [line.split()[1] for line in stdin.splitlines()[2:]])
preconditions.description: The second word in each action line ends with 's' (e.g., 'posted', 'commented', 'likes').

preconditions.expression: all(len(name) >= 1 and len(name) <= 10 and name.islower() for name in [line.split()[0] for line in stdin.splitlines()[2:]] + [line.split()[2].split(''')[0] for line in stdin.splitlines()[2:]])
preconditions.description: All names in actions (actor and target) are lowercase, 1-10 letters long, and consist of Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '\n'.join(sorted({name for line in stdin.splitlines()[2:] for name in line.split()[0:2] if name != stdin.splitlines()[0].strip()}, key=lambda name: (-priority[name], name)))
postconditions.description: The output lists all distinct names (excluding your name) from the actions, sorted by descending priority factor with you. If priorities are equal, names are sorted lexicographically ascending.

postconditions.expression: all(name in {line.split()[0] for line in stdin.splitlines()[2:]} or name in {line.split()[2].split(''')[0] for line in stdin.splitlines()[2:]} for name in stdout.strip().splitlines())
postconditions.description: Every name in the output appears as either an actor or target in at least one action.

postconditions.expression: all(name != stdin.splitlines()[0].strip() for name in stdout.strip().splitlines())
postconditions.description: Your name is excluded from the output.
